summary: Blends matching attributes across multiple input POPs using simple reductions such as average, add, multiply, min, max, or weighted proportional blending. Point, vertex, and primitive attributes can be blended in one operator.

key_params.name: blendtype
key_params.note: Blend operation such as average, add, min, max, or proportional

key_params.name: lengthmismatchnotif
key_params.note: Notification/action when input lengths do not match

key_concepts: Blend POP combines matching point, primitive, and vertex attributes across multiple POP inputs by element index.
Blend Type chooses simple reduction or weighted proportional behavior, while input blocks and CHOP weights provide per-input influence.
Length-mismatch controls and the Map page are important when inputs differ in size or when point attributes should drive blend weights.
common_gotchas: Inputs should have matching point/vertex/primitive counts unless the length mismatch behavior is intentionally configured.
Weighted modes can pull weights from attributes or CHOPs, so inspect both parameter and mapped weight sources.
Blend only affects attributes that exist in the selected scopes across inputs; missing attributes do not magically appear.
